title: feat(research): lower direct twiddle arithmetic to data tapes
body:
## Summary

Lower the direct one-pass synthetic-twiddle arithmetic to four sequential data tapes, closing PR3571's unit-head data-access handoff.

```text
borrowed physical address, read each cell once
  retain early low bits, then reuse their cells for branch bits
  ripple masked contributions through the narrow accumulator
  emit exact forward/opposite exponent
  erase private tapes; preserve address and return all heads
```

The author-written all-finite-shape proof derives exact reads/writes/unit moves/Boolean counts and capacity `A+max(1,d*max(a,1))+h+1+ell+1` data cells, plus at most eight Boolean transient values. Under the retained source bands this is O(p²) charged data work and O(p) data cells. Immutable shape scheduling, descriptor parsing/counters and consumer work are separate. No complete uniform encoded machine, total-machine superiority, supplier or kappa improvement is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3571 executes a random-access register producer and explicitly leaves tape lowering open; PR3550 executes supplied-circuit programs under a different reread/program contract.
  **After:** Actual four-tape execution agrees with independent named-bit arithmetic, canonical circuits and shape-derived access bills on 203,896 complete addresses across 700 fixtures, plus 30 wide evaluations through ell=256. The twelve-axis ell=8,K=4,h=5 forward example uses 138 data cells and 2,292 charged operations, including input/output, erasure and head returns.
- Fifteen malformed-boundary rejections, three actual failed-read restoration/retries and ten optimized CLI fault groups pass. Final publication-head CPython3.12 registered replay, normal/optimized science, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history check and actual committed Git-free science/controls pass; source/export bytes and shared runtime identity remain unchanged.
- Reproduce with `python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-twiddle-tapes` using a private external TMPDIR. README supplies direct and Git-free export commands. SOURCES.json pins all actual mathematical/runtime inputs in canonical ancestry at `20ecf289`; COMPARISONS.json keeps contextual pending heads separate. Scientific replay needs no foreign Git object or network.

The scope is an author-written data-tape proof and finite execution evidence. Independent human/formal acceptance, encoded control, actual signed-packet/layer consumption, arbitrary dirty-private restoration and the complete physical supplier invoice remain open. Canonical and frozen inputs and the selected frontier are unchanged. Credit remains with the named predecessor contributors and retained transform lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only the isolated new research/direct-twiddle-tapes package is added; its replay is explicitly registered.
